messages:
amanda_rs: Hey @channel — NimbusPay is asking for a tight compliance bundle to progress their POC. They want: SOC 2 excerpts (encryption + access control), an editable pen-test attestation they can include in procurement, a short list of third-party dependencies and mitigation cadence, and a pricing delta note for Dedicated w/ VPC + tenant isolation. Need it by Friday COB if possible.
liam_se: I can compile the tech artifacts. Plan: SOC2 excerpt (PDF) + single-page network diagram + pen-test attestation template (marked sample) + KMS/HSM note. Can someone confirm who at legal signs the pen-test on letterhead?
harper_security: Legal usually signs pen-test letters but we also have an external attestor we can route to for formal signatures. For the dependency list: we'll include top 10 infra OSS components and our patch cadence + vuln scan frequency. Also include a note on white/grey list for external scans.
ops_tara: For pricing: baseline hosted -> dedicated shared -> dedicated single-tenant w/ VPC -> full tenant isolation. The delta is mostly commit size (vGPU reserved) and network egress. I need their target sustained RPS and max seq to give accurate numbers. Amanda, do we have that?
amanda_rs: They gave an approximate: sustained 35 rps, average 1.5k tokens, occasional spike to 180 rps during batch jobs. Preferred region: eu-west but they asked about UK residency as a must-have if cost delta is reasonable.
liam_se: OK will prepare the artifacts. Question: do we offer a generic "signed by vendor" pen-test attestation for POCs or only unsigned template? Want to be clear in bundle.
harper_security: We can include unsigned template and explicitly call out the signatory flow: vendor-signed requires Legal approval and standard turnaround 3-5 business days; external attestor adds ~7 days. Put both options in the bundle.
ops_tara: I'll draft a simple pricing table with three rows: hosted, dedicated-shared, dedicated-isolated. Will annotate assumptions (35rps sustained, 180rps burst, seq lengths). Will post numbers here shortly.
liam_se: Draft customer note I'll send with bundle:
```
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached is a compact POC evidence pack: SOC2 excerpt (controls on encryption & access control), a pen-test attestation template (sample), a dependency + vulnerability management note, and a short pricing summary for Dedicated options. If you require a live external penetration test against our staging, let us know and we will schedule a 72-hour window and share approved IP ranges.

Happy to hop on a quick sync if you want to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Liam
```
harper_security: Also include a short bullet about key separation options: customer-managed KMS in Dedicated (bring-your-own keys) vs platform KMS with HSM-backed keys. That usually answers procurement and legal questions.
amanda_rs: Action items: Liam attach artifacts by EOD Thursday, Harper add dependency matrix + signatory note, Tara post pricing delta table + assumptions. I'll check with the customer whether they need an external scan. :thumbsup:
legal_bot: /remind liam_se to attach evidence bundle by 17:30 Thursday
liam_se: Got it, will upload bundle here by 17:30.
amanda_rs: Thanks team — if we can get the signed attestor option confirmed quickly that helps move the PO through. :rocket:
